男生很高兴，因为这个任务对他来说非常简单，他兴致勃勃的走过去，此刻由于很多同学都在执行纸条任务，因此没人关注他。
赵王孙和云凌辛两人交换了一个眼神，最终同意了关司令的条件。
此刻所有人都紧紧的捏着自己的黄纸，因为事实证明，这黄纸虽然对付不了鬼，但是却是能够起到警示的作用。
虽然他也知道，坐视不管等于是纵容救亡者公会动手。
但是，救亡者公会的实力太强大了，能轻易干掉金州，自然也能轻易干掉他们云水公会。
如果林炎此时没有分神开始想一些东西的话，他观察一下四周就可以发现，在座的所有人，几乎眼角的余光都在盯着林炎。
陈奥不愿相助，云露顿时不知该如何是好。
她更担心，自己迟迟不能得手，时间一长，心里的仇恨会慢慢变淡。
赵梁见有人冲过去了，他自然也是跟了上去，昌伟在山上见僵尸越来越多，连忙退了下来。
赵瑞也将洪图手里的古画拿过来看了看，没看出什么问题来，赵瑞又不是专业的鉴定师，更何况一般专业的鉴定师也不一定能看出这幅古画的问题。
赵瑞看不出这幅画的问题，就将画还给来洪图。
也不知道是秦晚的话起了作用，还是有别的原因在里面，在下一瞬间，所有从荷包里出来的鬼魂都静了下来，安安稳稳地停在原地，一个个跟被定住了似的。

Chapter 1,019 An old friend of Taiqing Peak cannot bear the humiliation (page 1)
Taiqing Peak Old Friend, Cannot Bear the Humiliation (Taiqing Peak Old Friend, Cannot Bear the Humiliation (Page 22) "Order the men from the Iron Armor Battalion to block the front, while the rest hide behind with spears to attack."
The boy was very happy because this task was very simple for him. He walked over happily. At this moment, because many classmates were performing the note task, no one paid attention to him.
Zhao Wangsun and Yun Lingxin exchanged glances and finally agreed to Commander Guan's conditions.
At this moment, everyone is holding their yellow paper tightly, because it turns out that although the yellow paper cannot deal with ghosts, it can serve as a warning.
Although he also knew that sitting back and doing nothing was tantamount to allowing the Saviors Guild to take action.
However, the Savior Guild is too powerful. It can easily kill Jinzhou, and naturally it can also easily kill their Yunshui Guild.
If Lin Yan had not been distracted and started thinking about something at this time, he would have noticed that everyone here was staring at Lin Yan from the corner of their eyes.
Chen Ao was unwilling to help, and Yunlu suddenly didn't know what to do.
She was even more worried that she would not be able to succeed for a long time, and as time went by, the hatred in her heart would slowly fade away.
When Zhao Liang saw someone rushing over, he naturally followed him. Chang Wei saw more and more zombies on the mountain and quickly retreated.
Zhao Rui also took the ancient painting in Hong Tu's hand and looked at it. He didn't see any problems. Zhao Rui was not a professional appraiser, not to mention that ordinary professional appraisers may not be able to see the problems with this ancient painting.
Zhao Rui could not see the problem with the painting, so he returned the painting to Lai Hongtu.
I don't know if Qin Wan's words had an effect or if there were other reasons. In the next moment, all the ghosts who came out of the purses quieted down and stopped peacefully, as if they were frozen.
